name: usda_psd
publisher: USDA FAS, Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD), coffee table
publication_delay: Plan rule: a marketing-year value is used only 12 months after the year ended. Marketing year Y (Y/Y+1) ends by 30 Sep Y+1 and is used from 1 Oct Y+2.
revision_policy: The file holds the last revised values, not the first estimates. The 12-month delay reduces this problem. World stocks-to-use has a break between 2001 and 2002 (0.92 -> 0.41, coverage change); only 2002 and later are used.
